values.value: Use when a new practice or facility is requesting to enroll as an authorized Allergan Moxie provider for the first time.

Dear [Contact.FirstName],
Thank you for your interest in enrolling [Account.Name] as an authorized Allergan Moxie provider. We are pleased to assist you through the credentialing and enrollment process for Case #[Case.CaseNumber].
To proceed with your new practice enrollment, the following documentation is required:
1. Completed Allergan Moxie Provider Enrollment Form (Form AM-PE-002), signed by the Medical Director. 2. Current DEA Certificate and State Controlled Substance License (if applicable for your practice scope). 3. Proof of malpractice/liability insurance — minimum $1,000,000 per occurrence / $3,000,000 aggregate. 4. A copy of the facility's business license or certificate of occupancy. 5. Completed and signed Patient Consent and Privacy Policy Acknowledgement (Form AM-PC-005).
Please note that incomplete applications may delay processing. All forms must be submitted together as a complete package.
Once we receive your complete submission, please allow 10-14 business days for review and credentialing verification. Our team will contact you if additional information is required.
We look forward to welcoming [Account.Name] to the Allergan Moxie provider network.
Kind regards, [User.FirstName] [User.LastName] Provider Enrollment Team Allergan Moxie
